llmProfileHint: Bind a fixed LLM profile to this agent (click "Save config" to apply). Priority: agent binding > task/session override > global active.
webSearchHintOn: Once enabled for this agent (click save above to apply), web_search can be used to search the internet
webSearchHintOff: Enable web search in "System Settings" and configure a backend first before enabling it here
interactiveShellHint: Once enabled for this agent (click save above to apply), persistent PTY session tools (shell_open/send/read/close/list) can drive interactive programs like msfconsole/ssh/REPL
variablesLabel: Variables (click to insert a placeholder; replaced with runtime data at render time)
promptPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the built-in default prompt
renderPreviewDesc: All '{{.Var}}' have been replaced with sample values by the backend.
loadedVersionToast: Loaded v{version} into the editor, confirm then click "Save as new version"
wrapupIntro: When this agent is terminated due to timeout or exhausted turns, the system injects this "wrap-up prompt" for one final pass: writing back anything identified but not yet persisted, then outputting a summary (to avoid an unfinished state). Leave empty to use the built-in default.
wrapupPlaceholderFallback: Leave empty to use the built-in default wrap-up prompt
wrapupTurnsLabel: Wrap-up turns (max turns for the wrap-up phase itself; 0 = built-in default of {turns} turns)
taskTimeoutIntro: Task timeout wrap-up (a separate set from the per-run wrap-up above): injected when the entire task reaches its timeout limit and is about to end. Often opposite in intent to the per-run prompt (e.g. for the planner: per-run says "don't stop, keep planning", task timeout says "stop now, make a final verdict"). Leave empty to use the built-in default.
taskTimeoutPlaceholderFallback: Leave empty to use the built-in default task timeout wrap-up prompt
taskTimeoutTurnsLabel: Wrap-up turns (0 = built-in default of {turns} turns)
mcpVisibilityHint: Check the MCP servers visible to this agent.
skillVisibilityHint: Check the Skills visible to this agent.
toolsBindHint: Check the built-in tools bound to this agent.
triggersIntro: Triggers let this custom agent run automatically: each trigger starts a new conversation (visible on the "Chat" page). Multiple trigger conditions can be selected; the system automatically appends "why this fired + related task/finding/goal" after the base message you write.
triggerBehaviorLabel: Post-trigger handling policy (how triggers queue/merge when run)
behaviorHintParallel: Parallel: each trigger immediately starts its own concurrent session, no merging; triggers beyond the max concurrency queue for a free slot.
behaviorHintSerialByTask: Serial · merge by task: one run at a time per agent; queued events for the same task are merged into one session.
behaviorHintSerialAll: Serial · merge all: one run at a time per agent; all currently queued triggers are merged into one session when picked up.
behaviorHintSerialNone: Serial · no merging: one run at a time per agent; each trigger gets its own session.
addTriggerLabel: Add trigger (each condition can have its own user message)
intervalPlaceholder: Message sent to the agent on each scheduled trigger, e.g.: inspect all tasks
onFindingLabel: Trigger when a finding is discovered
findingPlaceholder: Message sent to the agent when a finding is discovered (the system attaches the task and finding details)
onGoalMetLabel: Trigger when a goal is met
goalPlaceholder: Message sent to the agent when a goal is met (the system attaches the task and the goal that was met)
taskTimeoutPlaceholder: Message sent to the agent on task timeout (the system attaches the task id and goal)
toolCallHint: Select the tools to listen for (at least one); fires whenever one of these tools finishes a call during task execution. {count} selected.
toolCallPlaceholder: Message sent to the agent when the tool is called (the system attaches task info, tool input and output)
taskCreatePlaceholder: Message sent to the agent when a task is created (the system attaches the task id and goal)
wrapupSavedCustom: Wrap-up config saved (takes effect next run)
wrapupSavedCleared: Cleared; the built-in default will be used
ttWrapupSaved: Task timeout wrap-up config saved (takes effect next run)
atLeastOneCondition: Select at least one trigger condition
toolCallNeedsOneTool: Tool-call trigger needs at least one selected tool
